title: Valve's ep2_outland_11a (draft)
about: Valve's own ep2_outland_11a, measured by map_ingest.py on 2026-11-21 (play space only: hidden objects and the 3D skybox room left out) and drawn by map_view.py (flat colours; props are boxes of their true size, orange static, yellow physics, cyan dynamic, green NPCs; trees drawn as trunk and canopy, poles thin). Reference only: the VMF is not in the repo. DRAFT: a reviewer fills in what each picture teaches, picks the lessons, and removes "draft".
numbers: Things: 474 prop_static, 170 prop_physics, 33 prop_dynamic, 1 prop_door_rotating, 1 prop_ragdoll, 9 infodecal, 74 info_overlay, 15 keyframe_rope and 7 move_rope, 308 func_detail, 61 npc entities (makers included); left out: 2591 hidden objects and no 3D skybox room.
